items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: the first time I ever recorded was in California, on Victor, with the Quality Seranaders, Paul Howard's Quality Seranaders.

ctx.x: But that wasn't the first time you recorded, that was the first time you recorded with Duke Ellington.

Oh, the first time I ever recorded was in California, on Victor, with the Quality Seranaders, Paul Howard's Quality Seranaders. And then I recorded some with the other fellow, Mosby's. And then we recorded on our own name, Quality Seranaders. Paul -- I mean Lawrence, Charlie Lawrence was the orchestrator and arranger. You just made numbers and numbers everywhere.
Do you remember what you recorded --
Well, Lawrence Brown came here -- of course, he came here and the first thing he did was get sick. And he played with me.
When you say he came here, he wasn't born here.
